versions.changelog:
Initial public release.

- Provides a free, read-only security and health audit for OpenClaw hosts.
- Detects vulnerabilities, outdated software, and misconfigurations without making changes.
- Checks update status, firewall configuration, open ports, OS version, and running services.
- Generates a simple System Health Score report.
- Promotes an upgrade path to a Pro version with automated fixes and advanced features.
